description.value: Kojima Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in New Westminster offering a broad menu spanning sushi rolls, sashimi, bento boxes, BBQ, teriyaki, and noodle soups. Formerly operating as King Sushi, it has been at this location since 2013 and supports online ordering with quick 15-minute pickup — convenient for cyclists wanting a fast refuel. With an extensive vegetarian roll selection and over 259 customer reviews, it is a well-established neighbourhood stop.
